<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.12.4 -->

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix: reject mixed blocked DNS answers with IP allowlists by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15334
* fix(agent): compute recursion_limit accounting for middleware graph nodes by @premtiwari508 in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15362
* fix(ci): keep PR filenames out of shell scripts by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15328
* fix(twelvelabs): confine Split Video file reads by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15336
* fix(auth): replace Passlib with bcrypt on release-1.12.4 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15368
* fix(api): fail closed on unowned v1 build jobs by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15335
* fix: enforce admin policy for assistant execution by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15337
* fix(lfx): skip unsupported files when errors are silent by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15329
* fix: scope chat memory operations to flow and owner by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15346
* fix: validate public flows after group expansion by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15342
* fix(tracing): isolate tracer startup failures on 1.12.4 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15364
* fix(amazon): correct S3 uploader strategy and file inputs on 1.12.4 by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15366
* fix(ssrf): pin direct Requests helper connections by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15340
* fix: validate database connector bootstrap targets by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15332
* fix: allow administrator-scoped database TLS files by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15405
* fix: reject ambiguous Couchbase IPv4 seed prefixes by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15406
* fix(frontend): keep model picked during a model refresh by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15367
* fix(lfx): stop flow loads from resetting settings by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15372
* fix: block known pickle deserializers in generated components by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15345
* fix(security): protect Bing Search URL from run tweaks by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15330
* fix: restrict Celery broker messages to JSON by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15344
* fix(mcp): reject direct Node runtime options in stdio configs by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15338
* fix(files): sanitize batch archive entry names by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15339
* fix(agents): show iteration limit notice after text by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15369
* fix(watsonx): validate credentials with a regional model by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15353
* fix: hide stored flow credentials from shared readers by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15343
* fix(deps): 1.12.4 dependency upgrades by @Adam-Aghili in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15427
* fix: surface credential decryption failures at the default log level by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15434
* fix(knowledge-bases): keep ingested chunks within Chunk Size when a separator is set by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15421
* fix(authz): allow only one role per user per assignment scope by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15426
* fix(schema): sanitize underscore-prefixed field names in create_input_schema_from_json_schema by @TINGyu123644 in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15411
* fix(lfx): keep table markdown proportional to data by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15370
* fix(lfx): apply Chat Output clean data to single tables by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15420
* fix(lfx): reject inputs shadowed by component methods by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15373
* fix(authz): reject unknown result and actor_type filters on the audit query by @tarciorodrigues in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15424
* fix(release): scope the bundle PyPI guard to the build's lfx line by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15437
* fix(authz): reject role assignments for inactive users by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15453
* fix(frontend): keep flow lock saved during node update by @Cristhianzl in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15439
### 📝 Documentation Updates
* docs: custom component and local DB hardening by @mendonk in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15431
### ✅ Tests
* test: give TestPerformIngestionTask its own database by @erichare in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15423

## New Contributors
* @premtiwari508 made their first contribution in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15362
* @TINGyu123644 made their first contribution in https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/15411

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/compare/v1.12.3...v1.12.4
